title: An L¹ pairing that vanishes on uniform approximants vanishes in the limit
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, K ⊆ ℝⁿ measurable, G : ℝⁿ → ℝ integrable on K, f : ℝⁿ → ℝ AE-strongly measurable for Lebesgue measure restricted to K with |f(x)| ≤ C for all x ∈ K. Suppose that for every ε > 0 there is g : ℝⁿ → ℝ, AE-strongly measurable for Lebesgue measure restricted to K, with |f(x) − g(x)| ≤ ε for all x ∈ K and ∫_K G·g = 0. Then ∫_K G·f = 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (K : Set (Euclid n)) (G f : Euclid n → ℝ) (C : ℝ), MeasurableSet K → IntegrableOn G K volume → AEStronglyMeasurable f (volume.restrict K) → (∀ x ∈ K, |f x| ≤ C) → (∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ g : Euclid n → ℝ, AEStronglyMeasurable g (volume.restrict K) ∧ (∀ x ∈ K, |f x - g x| ≤ ε) ∧ ∫ x in K, G x * g x = 0) → ∫ x in K, G x * f x = 0
